# **Gaps — no SOP yet**

- **Member Onboarding** – no documented first-touch-to-first-class flow; likely inconsistent experience, missed upsell/retention hooks
- **Cancellation & Churn** – no exit interview, win-back trigger, or data capture; losing intel on why members leave
- **Member Checkins** – no cadence or script for engagement touch-points between classes; retention leaks early
- **Coaching Development Roadmap** – no progression criteria, skill gaps, or upskilling path; coaches plateau, quality drifts
- **Class Quality Audit Checklist** – no standardized review mechanism; can't measure consistency or coach performance objectively
- **Member data privacy & GDPR** – high-risk gap for a UK gym; no documented consent, data handling, or breach protocol
- **Referral Programme** – no structure to incentivize/track member advocacy; leaving growth on the table
- **Order Supplies & Sundries** – no reorder triggers, vendor management, or stock levels; operational friction
- **Troubleshooting Guide** – no escalation path for common member complaints (injuries, billing, class access issues)

---

# **Needs updating**

- **Coach SOPs (19/22)** – "Weekly Key Coach Tasks" listed as missing; coaches likely unclear on admin/prep expectations vs. floor time
- **Client SOPs (26/36)** – "Member Pause," "Milestone Achievements," "30 Day Goals," "Member Outcomes" all absent; no structured goal-tracking or milestone celebration engine for retention
- **Marketing (5/5)** – likely assumes organic flow; no documented tie to referral, win-back, or member testimonial capture
- **Facilities (7/8)** – missing supplies/reorder SOP creates downstream service gaps; audit

# Service Menu Execution for The Forge

• **Start with your revenue reality, not your wishlist** — Pull your last 3 months of actual bookings/sales data. Map what members actually *buy* (classes, PT sessions, challenges, retail?) vs. what you *think* you offer. Build the menu around what's working, not what sounds good.

• **Two separate documents, one visual language** — Coaches need a backend operation sheet (class formats, pricing tiers they quote, upsell triggers, package breakpoints). Members get a clean, Instagram-ready visual menu (prices, what's included in each tier, comparison table). Same info, different packaging. Get a designer to make the member version in 1-2 hours, not weeks.

• **Price anchor strategy — nail the "why" before the numbers** — Don't just list prices. For each service tier, write the *outcome* members get (e.g., "Unlimited classes + monthly form check = confidence in compound lifts"). Coaches sell outcomes, not features. This also prevents pricing questions because the value is baked in.

• **Eliminate decision paralysis with 3-tier structure** — Basic (entry classes), Core (classes + 1 PT session/month), Premium (unlimited + weekly PT + early booking). Forces members to self-select instead of drowning in options. Makes coaching upsells obvious.

• **Version 1 goes live in 7 days, not "when it's perfect"** — Get it documented, printed, and on the gym wall this week. You'll learn what's broken from member questions, not from perfectionism. Iterate monthly.
